verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The added tests exercise the real RDF 1.2 canonicalization entry points and make byte-exact, non-vacuous assertions for VT and all U+000E–U+001F escapes, including LF/FF boundary behavior. Named-node and blank-node graph labels are tested through Quad-based canonicalization with the document trailing newline, and the round-trip assertion correctly preserves a fourth graph term while omitting DefaultGraph. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue was found.
